intervals.label: established as the Smithsonian Mount Hopkins Observatory
intervals.note: The same page says of Fred Lawrence Whipple: "During his tenure, SAO developed the Mount Hopkins Observatory, which was renamed for Whipple in 1981."
intervals.quote: From its establishment in 1966 as the Smithsonian Mount Hopkins Observatory, FLWO has hosted a world-class suite of telescopes designed for a wide variety of purposes.

intervals.label: VERITAS hosted at FLWO
intervals.note: Interval reflects when VERITAS itself began at this pre-existing observatory; the observatory's own start (1966) is the first interval.
intervals.quote: Installation of VERITAS prototype telescope at the FLWO Basecamp

name: Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory
notes: Established in 1966 as the Smithsonian Mount Hopkins Observatory and renamed for Fred Lawrence Whipple in 1981 (CfA FLWO page). The Whipple 10 m telescope (experiment:whipple-10m, construction from 1966) and VERITAS (from 2003) are its gamma-ray instruments.

operator.note: VERITAS is supported by/hosted at the Smithsonian's Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory; the exact operator sentence names the Smithsonian Institution among the observatory's supporting bodies.

summary.plain: A mountain observatory in southern Arizona, home to the VERITAS gamma-ray telescopes among other instruments.
summary.technical: Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory site on Mount Hopkins, Arizona, at 1268 m altitude, hosting VERITAS since 2003.
